Daylight enters simple tall windows along the side walls and at the far end, consistent with the original hall having windows on every side. Plain worn stone or brick flooring. Curving rows of simple wooden benches on low timber tiers, narrow wooden steps and aisles for a republican civic assembly. Leave the room predominantly empty, with only a few tiny fictional citizens in subdued fifteenth-century wool cloaks, seated far away and seen only from behind.

Rectilinear lens perspective, coherent architectural proportions, detailed grain of real timber and soft imperfections in plaster. Do not simulate an impossible panorama.
Lighting and style: ordinary natural window daylight, soft shadows, muted beige, grey and brown colours, plausible camera exposure and focus. Authentic photographic surface texture; no drawing, painting, illustration texture, CGI look, cinematic drama, HDR or exaggerated saturation.
Critical exclusions: no frescoes, murals, paintings, ornate painted or gilded ceiling panels, statues, present-day museum furnishings, modern lights, museum displays or barriers.
